answer: In an agent market for jade ornaments, willow baskets and saffron, trading-volume rewards can invite fake sales between aliases. Charge an irreversible 1% settlement fee and cap all rebates for both sides combined at 0.2% of the same payment. Pay the fee to an independent service, never to an account chosen by the traders. A seller buying from its own aliases then loses at least 0.8% per round trip, even if it collects every rebate. This deters rebate farming only when other bonuses cannot exceed that loss; it does not prove buyers are independent.
